identityStatus: Named OpenStreetMap way 187024367 fixes the outline, orientation and measured 35.1 by 30.7 m quadrangle. The western and rear profiles follow the Friedrich Lange postcard pair.

terrainContact.basis: Unmodified Copernicus GLO-30 at the centerline of the principal southern gate. The continuous sandstone foundation covers the sampled perimeter variation.

notes: Postcard scans establish the relative height of the tower and parapets, the front arched gate and overhanging oriel, narrow arched stone openings and corbel bands.
